description: MATERIAL: Premium carbide-steel construction built to resist intense impact and high heat. TIP GEOMETRY: Features 130° Douglas-form carbide tips that ensure fast material penetration and long service life. FLUTE DESIGN: Optimized spiral flutes rapidly clear out dust and debris, minimizing friction and preventing breakage. SHANK TYPE: Standard straight shank, making it highly compatible with standard rotary or percussion/hammer drills. APPLICATIONS: Ideal for drilling anchor, plastic plug, fixing, or pipework clearance holes in masonry, brick, blockwork, concrete, and natural stone. INCLUDED COMPONENTS: The set comes packaged in a compact, durable plastic cassette case that keeps the bits securely spaced, organized, and protected during transport. It includes one bit of each of the following diameters: 4 mm, 5 mm, 6 mm, 8 mm, 10 mm.
